cards.title: MoE Routing
cards.description: Routing decisions in sparse models determine which experts activate for each token. Poor routing collapses expert diversity, wastes capacity, and degrades throughput. We study routing objectives that jointly optimize specialization, load balance, and latency under hard deployment budgets.

cards.title: Sparse Computation
cards.description: Dense models activate far more parameters than any given input requires. We study structured and unstructured sparsity patterns that eliminate that waste without compromising training stability, and characterize how sparse activations degrade under distribution shift and hardware constraints.

cards.title: Training Stability
cards.description: Large-scale training runs fail in ways that are expensive to debug and hard to reproduce. We develop measurable stability indicators and early-warning signals for loss spikes and divergence, targeting training configurations that remain robust across model scale and architecture changes.

cards.title: Inference Optimization
cards.description: Deploying large models is a systems problem. Quantization, speculative decoding, KV caching, and adaptive batching interact in non-obvious ways that depend on workload and hardware. We study how to compose these techniques into serving pipelines that hold quality under throughput pressure.
